caption: OMIM facts conveyed (top; primary endpoint) and causal gene F1 (bottom) for the memory-only control (black squares) and direct reading (blue circles), as means over entries by creation era (MIM-number range of the entry; n = compared entries per band). Hollow markers at right are a separate set of entries created in 2026, chosen by creation date alone and not used in developing the strategies; 20 of the 30 run are compared, since an entry counts only if every strategy completed it and stopped replies were frequent there. The memory-only control conveys 24.1% of facts for the 600000–609999 band but 5.7% for 620000 onward and 7.0% for the 2026 set (causal gene F1 41.2% and 30.0%), whereas direct reading conveys 51.2–53.9% from the 600000 band on (52.2% for the 2026 set) and reaches 100.0% gene F1 everywhere except the classic band (87.0%). The model's training cut-off is not known, so this is a contamination check, not proof that the reading results are free of memorisation: from the 600000 band on, direct reading's coverage of facts from abstract-only papers also declines with creation era (49.8% to 37.9%, pooled over facts).
description: Two vertically stacked line-and-marker panels sharing one x axis; 5.5 x 3.67 in (full text width, include with width=\textwidth), Liberation Sans, all text 8 pt. x: five creation-era bands of the main set at positions 0-4, joined by lines, tick labels with range and n (1xxxxx-5xxxxx classic n=18; 600000-609999 n=19; 610000-615999 n=20; 616000-619999 n=19; 620000 onward n=17), then after a gap and a grey dashed rule an unconnected position 'created 2026' (n=20) with hollow markers. Top panel 'OMIM facts conveyed (%)': memory only (#000000 squares) 14.5/24.1/17.5/12.6/5.7, direct reading (#0072B2 circles) 34.9/53.9/51.2/51.4/53.5; 2026 set 7.0 vs 52.2. Bottom panel 'Causal gene F1 (%)': memory 88.9/94.7/100.0/89.5/41.2, direct 87.0/100.0/100.0/100.0/100.0; 2026 set 30.0 vs 100.0. Small horizontal dodge (+/-0.07) keeps coinciding points visible. Direct labels instead of a legend; y 0-100 with ticks every 25; light horizontal grid. Data: experimental_log.md Sec. 2.11 (entry means) and Sec. 10 (2026 set, headline table). No error bars (Sec. 2.11 gives none). Saved as PNG (300 dpi) and PDF.
